caption: The drawing depicts a dark brown, sculpted figure of two cats sitting side by side on an oval base. The cats are positioned closely together, both facing forward, with their bodies and heads touching. Each cat has distinct facial features, including round eyes, small triangular ears, and pronounced snouts with whiskers. One cat has its right paw raised and touching a ball placed at the center base in front of them. The second cat has a ribbon tied around its neck. The entire group sits on a slightly elevated, dark oval pedestal with a beveled edge. The background is a plain, light tan color with no additional objects or details. The artist's signature is visible on the left lower corner of the image.
title: Door Stop
